definitions.explanation: The Romance language originating in Spain, spoken as a native language in Spain, most of Latin America, and several other countries.

examples.japanese: スペイン{語|ご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}している→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
スペイン{語|ご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{二番目|にばんめ}→二番目：30362_nibanme⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{母語話者|ぼごわしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{言語|げんご}→言語：02717_gengo⟧だ。
examples.english: Spanish is the language with the second-largest number of native speakers in the world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{第二外国語|だいにがいこくご}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧スペイン{語|ご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦{南米|なんべい}→南米：04285_nanbei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}きたい→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧だ。
examples.english: I chose Spanish as my second foreign language at university because I wanted to work in South America in the future.

notes:
Formed from スペイン (Spain) + ⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧ (language). Spanish is one of the more popular foreign languages studied in Japan, especially at the university level as a {第二外国語|だいにがいこくご} (second foreign language). Japanese has borrowed some words from Spanish, particularly through early contact with Portuguese and Spanish missionaries in the 16th century.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スペイン{語|ご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to speak Spanish
- スペイン{語|ご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧: Spanish class
- スペイン{語|ご}⟦{圏|けん}→圏：21183_ken⟧: Spanish-speaking world
- スペイン{語|ご}⟦{検定|けんてい}→検定：13131_kentei⟧: Spanish language proficiency test

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ポルトガル{語|ご}→ポルトガル語：29235_porutogarugo⟧: Portuguese — closely related Romance language
- ⟦フランス{語|ご}→フランス語：24509_furansugo⟧: French — another popular second foreign language choice in Japanese universities
- ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧: English — the primary foreign language studied in Japan
